The Principles and Practice of Computed Tomography Volume Rendering
Computed Tomography (CT) revolutionized medical diagnostics by allowing clinicians to visualize cross-sectional anatomy. However, traditional CT outputs consist of a series of two-dimensional (2D) slice images, requiring mental reconstruction by the observer.
